> walk stage of support-copilot: recomposes the Crawl root (base, Crawl components, the namespace child) and adds what the records require for walk, nothing the plan put out of scope.
> images: is the write-back surface: sync-app-image.yml (repository_dispatch app-image-updated) sets the SHA with yq, never sed.
